---
title: Document *title*
citation:
  title: ''
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"][content="Document title"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Title']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['<em>Title</em>']
---

An empty `citation: title:` falls back to the document `title`.
